source_basis.predecessor_source_reuse: Pure computational continuation of the role-local certified pair-count policies; no new external empirical claim introduced.

batch_model.batch_semantics: Launch b paired observations concurrently. Results are processed in a fixed within-batch order for the exact curtailed sign rule, but the full batch is paid once launched; unused in-flight slots cannot be reclaimed for the next adaptively generated candidate.
batch_model.round_latency_model: One deterministic latency unit per launched batch. q95 wall rounds are the q95 of the sum over candidate stages of ceil(N_stage/b) until false commit or exhaustion of all 20 candidates.
batch_model.paid_pair_occupancy: b times launched batch rounds. This intentionally distinguishes elapsed rounds from accelerator/pair occupancy.
batch_model.scope_guard: No claim yet for variable rollout latency, stragglers, cross-candidate parallelism, asynchronous cancellation, or a pre-frozen candidate pool.

exact_method: For each action, integrate its exact null curtailed survive/reject discordant-count law against the NegativeBinomial(d,.20) pair waiting-time law, then map N pairs to ceil(N/b) batch rounds. Sequentially convolve survive mass and terminate on reject exactly as in the pair-count model. This yields the exact all-null q95 batch-round distribution for each already-certified ordered policy.

naive_divide_underestimation.cause: Candidate-level serialization and batch-fragmentation waste. A total-pair q95 divided by concurrency ignores partially filled final batches at many candidate stages.

wall_round_frontier_changes.b2_b4_b8: The 29 certified policies remain strictly ordered by q95 batch rounds in increasing power.
wall_round_frontier_changes.b16_b32: Three adjacent pair-count breakpoints collapse to equal q95 wall rounds: 1857 vs 1867, 3078 vs 3087, and 3285 vs 3295. The higher-power policy therefore wall-clock dominates the lower-power policy at those q95 round budgets, reducing the evaluated frontier from 29 to 26 distinct wall-round points.
wall_round_frontier_changes.interpretation: Pair-count Pareto optimality is not identical to wall-clock Pareto optimality once batch granularity is coarse. Even before modeling stragglers, some lower-power pair-optimal points become dominated.

rejected_or_narrowed_generalizations: Rejected: q95 wall time is approximately ceil(q95 total pairs / batch size). Candidate-stage fragmentation adds a persistent 7-10 batch-round q95 penalty in the tested policies.
Rejected: increasing within-candidate batch parallelism is free. b=32 cuts wall rounds sharply but increases q95 paid-pair occupancy by roughly 9-19% across the tested frontier.
Rejected under b>=16 for the evaluated policies: every pair-count breakpoint remains wall-clock nondominated. Three lower-power points tie the next higher-power point in q95 rounds.
Narrowed: this is an exact evaluation of the already-certified ordered policies, not yet a global reoptimization over multiset/order/batch-size jointly.

frontier.action: Jointly optimize action multiset, power-feasible ordering, and batch size for q95 wall rounds plus paid-pair occupancy; do not assume the pair-count-optimal policy remains wall-clock optimal.

Add variable rollout-time and straggler distributions, including candidate/incumbent paired completion as max(T_candidate,T_incumbent), and test synchronous batches versus asynchronous refill/cancellation.
Model when candidate identities are pre-frozen enough to permit cross-candidate audit concurrency without violating adaptive-generation validity; compare against the serialized baseline.
Broaden discordant depths beyond {10,20,30,50} under the wall-clock objective.

frontier.exact_next_action: Solve the wall-round objective directly rather than post-processing pair-optimal policies: for b in {4,8,16,32}, enumerate the admissible action multisets, use a power-constrained ordering DP whose cost state is exact batch-round CDF, and identify whether any pair-count-suboptimal multiset dominates the current 26-29 wall-round frontier points.
